context: 2026-10-26 actual local Laravel HTTP/SQLite/database sessions and queue; main base deea998 plus #29 implementation. Synthetic users, seeded OTP verification through real sessions. Temporary router simulates strict OpenAI completion/malformed output and one storage failure; not shipped. Actual queue worker uses array mail only; no external customer/provider/deployed Reverb proof. All secrets/cookies/OTP omitted. Six extra requests use a second isolated fixture for updated read/legacy/deletion behavior. Five final requests use a separate isolated fixture for configurable reminder policy and public workspace context. Five final mail requests prove an explicitly reviewed seeded uncertain record is accepted once by a real database queue worker using the local array transport (sent/attempts2; one prior attempt is synthetic). No external delivery claim. Fourteen route-specific conflict/validation requests use another isolated synthetic fixture.
